name: The Severed Head
summary: Vigorous digging turns up the head of a male orc, ragged where it was cut from the neck. Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village is the one to bring it to.

sections.title: A Grim Find
sections.body: Digging hard in the loose dirt brings up an orc's head, a male's, ragged where it was cut from the neck. The lips are drawn in a snarl and the dark eyes glare defiantly. Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village is the one to bring it to.

sections.title: Nazeer Looks Closer
sections.body: Nazeer Bloodpike knows the head at once as Marg Nighteye's, and had feared Marg was dead. Studying the ragged wound on the neck, Nazeer wonders whether a weapon made the cut or some beast killed the agent. It is a mystery to be solved, and Nazeer wants to know whether the Alliance was behind Marg's death.

faq.q: Where do you bring the severed head?
aliases: where to turn in severed head
faq.answer: To Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: What does the head look like?
aliases: what is in the loose dirt
faq.answer: An orc's, a male's, ragged where it was cut from the neck, with a snarl on the lips and dark eyes that glare defiantly.

faq.q: What comes after the severed head?
faq.answer: The next step is The Troll Witchdoctor.
